Emaar India's flagship projects include Emaar Palm Hills, The Avenues, Digital Greens, Emaar Palm Heights, Emaar Imperial Garden, and Emaar Business District 114. Emaar India has launched its largest residential project, Serenity Hills, in Sector 86, Gurugram, which is positioned as one of the greenest projects in the city with IGBC Platinum pre-certification. Other notable projects include Emaar Emerald Hills, Emaar Continental City, and Emaar Business District, Gurugram. Emaar India's commercial projects include EMAAR Capital Tower, Mgf Metropolis Mall, and Capital Tower, all located in Gurugram.

Speaking at the launch, Mr. Kalyan Chakrabarti, CEO of Emaar India, said, “We are excited to introduce Serenity Hills, a project that truly reflects Emaar’s unwavering commitment to quality, design, and commitment to nature, evoking Emaar’s ‘Product First’ philosophy. At Emaar, we continuously raise the bar of excellence with every project, creating spaces that seamlessly blend aesthetic brilliance with functionality and sustainability. Serenity Hills is envisioned as a tranquil oasis within [...] Gurugram: Emaar India, the Indian arm of Dubai-based real estate major Emaar Properties, has launched its largest premium residential project, Serenity Hills, in Sector 86, Gurugram. The high-rise development, spread over 25.9 acres, is being positioned as one of the greenest projects in the city with IGBC Platinum pre-certification and more than 20 acres of landscaped open space [...] The project’s landscape, with an 8-acre central green, is inspired by the tail ridge of the Aravalli range, with forested trails and water bodies. Designed with an open-space layout, nearly 80% of the units will face green spaces or be corner apartments. The project offers a mix of 3BHK and 4BHK residences, with the majority being 3BHK units.

Emaar India positions itself competitively in the Indian real estate market, leveraging international backing, project scale, and pan-India presence to differentiate through premium branding, turnkey solutions, and bundled amenities. The company focuses primarily on residential projects in high-demand corridors such as Delhi NCR, with an emphasis on premium housing, mid-market homes, and integrated community developments. Emaar MGF operates within a competitive ecosystem with peers like DLF, Oberoi Realty, and Brigade Group, and uses pricing psychology to turn price into a conversion tool, offering incentives like free parking, no floor rise charges, stamp duty waivers, furnishing vouchers, buy-back assurances, and price protection till possession to enhance affordability and buyer confidence.

For example, in Ahmedabad, Emaar launched a project called Emaar Emerald in Bopal. Prices started around Rs 45-55 lakhs for a 2BHK. But the experience? It felt more like a local builder than a global luxury brand. Why? Because the processes, the timelines, and the after-sales service are adapted to the Indian market. [...] What many buyers overlook is the rental yield. In Dubai, Emaar properties yield 6-8% annually. In India, it is 2-4%. So, if you are an investor, Dubai might be better. But if you are an end-user in Gujarat, Emaar India offers good value for money, especially in areas like GIFT City or Bopal.

### RERA and Legal Aspects: A Key Difference [...] The reality is that in Dubai, Emaar operates in a mature, regulated market. In India, they face local challenges: land acquisition, approvals, and labor issues. So, while the brand is the same, the buyer experience is not.
